usage: Repo-scoped CodeScene overrides. Keep each rule_set narrowly scoped and justify it in matching_content_path_doc, so a reader can tell a deliberate exemption from an unexamined one.

rule_sets.matching_content_path_doc: Domain types model the vocabulary the rest of the backend speaks, so their constructors and conversions legitimately take several string-like fields in a row: an identifier, a display name, a slug. Grouping them into a context type would add a value that is constructed once and immediately unpacked at every call site, and the alternative, newtyping each field, is a separate design decision rather than something this rule should force. Reassess if a domain constructor grows past a handful of arguments, or if the same run of strings starts appearing in signatures outside this directory.
